title: Pehli Holi Outfit for New Bride: First Holi Ideas for 2027
excerpt: Pehli Holi outfit ideas for a new bride abroad: a festive puja look, a practical colour play look, and gifting tips for in-laws and family.
body:
For your pehli Holi as a new bride, plan two outfits: a festive puja look such as a gota work Anarkali or an embroidered kurta set in a rich colour, and a separate cotton kurta set to play colour in. Add bridal touches like bangles and sindoor if your family follows them, and keep the play look light and practical.

This guide is for newly married women celebrating their first Holi abroad, whether with in-laws in the USA, UK, Canada, UAE or Australia, or with both families on a video call. A [lavender taffeta silk gota work Anarkali suit set](/products/lavender-taffeta-silk-gota-work-anarkali-suit-set-with-organza-dupatta/) is a graceful pick for the puja.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. Every piece is made in our own Jaipur unit, where our block prints are hand printed by karigars.*

## What should a new bride wear for her first Holi?

The first Holi after marriage is special in many families. Relatives want to welcome the new bride, there are often extra photos, and you may be introduced to community friends for the first time. Customs vary a lot by family and region, so it is worth asking your mother-in-law or your own mother what is expected.

Many new brides dress up for the morning puja and then change for colour play. This keeps the special outfit safe and lets you relax once the gulal comes out. Holi falls in late March 2027 (check your local calendar), so plan both looks around the weather where you live.

## How should you plan your puja look and your play look?

| Moment | Outfit | Colour ideas | Styling |
|---|---|---|---|
| Morning puja | Gota work or embroidered Anarkali | Lavender, pink, red, sage | Bangles, dupatta on the head if asked |
| Colour play | Cotton block print kurta set | Mint, teal, grey | Hair tied up, minimal jewellery |
| Lunch or evening | Bandhani or chanderi set | Purple, coral | Fresh dupatta, statement earrings |
| Video call with family | Your puja look | Any rich shade | Good light, dupatta framing the face |

## Which outfits work best for the pehli Holi puja?

### A gota work Anarkali

Gota is a traditional Rajasthani metallic ribbon work that catches light beautifully. A gota Anarkali feels bridal without being heavy, and at $52 it becomes a go-to for every family function this year. You can browse more in our [Anarkali suits](/anarkali-suits-online-usa-uk/) collection.

### A bandhani Anarkali

Bandhani is tie-dye, and it is often linked with celebrations and new brides in Rajasthan and Gujarat. The [purple bandhani chiffon Anarkali suit set with hand-embroidered neckline](/products/purple-bandhani-chiffon-anarkali-suit-set/) at $52 brings that festive feel and moves beautifully when you walk.

### An embroidered chanderi kurta set

If your family prefers a kurta set to an Anarkali, the [coral pink chanderi kurta set with hand-embroidered yoke](/products/coral-pink-chanderi-hand-embroidered-kurta-pant-dupatta-set/) at $52 is soft, warm and photogenic. Coral looks warm and bright even in grey spring light.

> **From our Jaipur studio:** Taffeta silk has a gentle body that holds the flare of an Anarkali, and gota work sits flat and catches light without feeling scratchy. Chanderi is lighter, with a soft sheen. If your puja is indoors under warm lights, both photograph well; for a long day on your feet, chanderi is the easier choice.

## What should a new bride wear to play colour?

Change into a cotton kurta set you are happy to get messy. Your in-laws will likely want to put the first colour on you, so expect a lot of gulal and plenty of photos.

The [mint green hand block print cotton kurta pant dupatta set with hand work yoke](/products/mint-green-hand-block-print-cotton-kurta-pant-dupatta-set-with-hand-work-yoke/) at $48 is festive enough for the photos and practical enough to play in. Tie your hair up, swap gold jewellery for simple bangles, and keep your phone in a pouch. If the weather is cold where you live, a thin thermal under the kurta keeps you comfortable without changing the look.

A few practical things to keep ready:

- A second set of bangles you do not mind getting coloured
- Hair ties and a small comb
- A towel and a bag for wet clothes
- A fresh outfit for lunch

Touch the elders' feet or greet them first if that is your family's custom, and let them start the colour.

## Frequently asked questions

**What colour should a new bride wear on her first Holi?**
Rich festive colours such as red, pink, lavender and coral are popular for the puja. For play, choose a cotton outfit in a mid-tone that hides colour.

**Should a new bride wear white on Holi?**
Many families prefer brides to wear colour rather than plain white for their first Holi. Ask your elders, as customs vary.

**How many outfits does a new bride need for pehli Holi?**
Usually two: one for the puja and photos, and one for colour play. A third clean outfit for lunch is a nice extra.
